water_loss_kpi.title: Total water losses

technical_definition.text: Total (apparent and real) losses, expressed in terms of annual volume lost per service connection per day.
technical_definition.formula_text: ((System input volume - Authorised consumption volume) in m³ × 1000) / (365 × Number of service connections)

water_loss_kpi.policy: Preserve the literal summary value and technical definition separately. Do not normalize, convert, derive a per-case deadline, or treat this as a repair-response SLA until the responsible metric owner clarifies units/denominator.

decision_rule: Do not select a candidate from public KPI text alone.
Prefer the candidate with a named operational owner, written data-use permission, a defined work package, a lawful payer/procurement route, usable baseline and independent completion evidence.
Require a job-quality plan with paid hours, safety, training/credentials, timely payment and 6/12-month retention measures.
If neither candidate satisfies G2, remain in synthetic/shadow research and do not announce funded positions.
